flyer.justification: The flyer is well-structured and engaging, but the title exceeds the strict 6-word limit requirement.

linkedin.justification: The post flows well and captures key insights without banned buzzwords, but it failed to include the required 3-5 hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all formatting constraints precisely, including a short subject line, three structured bold subheadings, and strong editorial tone.

instagram.justification: The Instagram caption perfectly incorporates visual carousel cues, punchy emoji-bulleted lines, call to action, and exactly 10 relevant hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive summary effectively covers TL;DR, evidence, discussion points, and action items in clean Markdown under the word limit.

blog.justification: The blog post adheres thoroughly to all format requirements, including numbered insights, comparison table, conclusion, and author bio.
